First listed 2026-10-21 · episode or wrap

AI, FICO & the Next Big Risks in Financial Services

Eisman and Collins survey FICO competition, AI risks to insurance and idle cash, payment networks, bank mergers, software refinancing, rates, life insurers and crypto regulation. Eisman explicitly endorses several concerns in his closing summary. FHFA verifies pricing parity; Senate records verify CLARITY's procedural defeat. The claim that no direct-lending index exists is incorrect. Eisman's leveraged-equity arithmetic is valid under fixed-debt assumptions, while the broad software markdown premise is unverified and the refinancing forecast is still ahead.

Substack · 2026-10-21 ↗
The episode has many separable theses, with conditional AI risks and refinancing arithmetic distinct from observed outcomes. Recording date is September 30, three weeks before publication. Permanently dead legislation is not established by one failed vote.

substack-220412338-c032 · explanation

If a company bought with 50% debt loses half its enterprise value while debt remains unchanged, its residual equity value is wiped out.

Right
Source · 26:20-26:27 ↗
SpeakerSteve Eisman
Stanceconditional
Horizonnot stated
Materialitysupporting

Let initial EV be 100 and net debt 50; after EV falls to 50, residual equity is zero. This does not verify the real-world premises.

Conditional reasoning

Equity=max(EV-net debt,0). Initial EV=100 and debt=50; a 50% EV decline leaves EV=50 and debt=50, so equity=0. Assumes no debt amortization, retained cash, additional assets or option value.

Assessment test: Apply equity = enterprise value minus net debt under the stated fixed-debt assumptions.

Evidence and assessment details

Attribution confidence: high. Assessment confidence: high. Thesis family: leveraged-equity-arithmetic.

No independent empirical outcome evidence is attached. A principle, disclosure or unfinished forecast is not a verified investment win.

How he reasons here

  • Distinguish current earnings from future franchise erosion.
  • Examine granular idle balances rather than assume all low-cost deposits migrate.
  • Separate payment interfaces from network rails.
  • Separate operating earnings, enterprise multiples, debt and residual equity.
  • Use regulatory incentives and merger economics rather than management narrative alone.
